fields.name: level
fields.description: This is not the building tier.All buildings should start at level 0 and go up by 1for each consecutive level of the building.The building tier is defined by the columnprimary_slot_building_building_level_requirement

fields.name: resource_transaction_on_complete
fields.description: A scoped transaction to be applied upon completing the building

fields.name: override_startpos_settlement_display_building
fields.description: If true, when this building level becomes the region's primary building, it will be treated as a display override, allowing its configured BMDs to be shown on the campaign map. The settlement display system normally only renders models from the building chain established at startpos (with culture-specific BMD variants selected via building_culture_overrides), or from a chain substituted via script using override_building_chain_display; this flag bypasses that restriction without changing the underlying startpos chain.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Higher number will be displayed lower down the list. Set to 0 to hide the effect entirely.

fields.name: is_positive_value_good
fields.description: If true, then positive values shown green in ui. Otherwise shown red and vice versa for negatives. (As sometimes -10% is a good thing like cost)
